'''Partainu''' was the fifth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] of [[Deel]] in the [[Neimoidia system/Legends|Neimoidia system]]. Located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]], it was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]].
